episodes.final_message: It is completely understandable to feel overwhelmed with three deadlines today; please be kind to yourself as you navigate this heavy load. To make things feel a bit more manageable, try picking just one priority task and working on it for a single 25-minute block, followed by a short, restorative walk outside to clear your head. You don't have to do it all at once, and reaching out to a friend for a quick check-in might help you feel a little less isolated while you work.

I noticed you have two deadlines today and your activity levels have been a bit lower than usual. Since I don't have your recent sleep or stress data, how are you holding up this evening—would you like a quick break idea or some space?

I'm so sorry to hear you're feeling a 'blizzard of emotions' today with those three deadlines; please know that you don't have to carry this weight alone. If you need someone to talk to, Dartmouth's Counseling Center at Dick's House is available at (603) 646-9442, or you can reach the 24/7 Crisis Text Line by texting HOME to 741741. For now, please try to step away from your desk for just five minutes of fresh air or a few slow breaths—you've been working incredibly hard and deserve a moment of kindness.
